title: Impact of Negative Weights on Performance in Reservoir Computing
abstract: arXiv:2611.06051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reservoir computing provides an efficient framework for time-series prediction because only the readout layer is trained while the recurrent reservoir remains fixed. In this study, we examine how the negative sign ratio of a signed Erdos-Renyi reservoir affects the internal dynamics and forecasting performance of an echo state network on the Mackey-Glass benchmark. To characterize the reservoir responses, we use two Shannon-entropy-based observables, namely node-state entropy and node-frequency entropy, as empirical proxies for the diversity of reservoir states and temporal activation patterns. We find that intermediate negative sign ratios are associated with richer internal dynamics and substantially lower prediction error than the sign-homogeneous extremes for the task considered here. translated_title: 负权重对储备池计算性能的影响
translated_abstract: 储备池计算为时间序列预测提供了一种高效框架，因为只有读出层需要训练，而循环储备池保持固定。在本研究中，我们考察了带符号Erdős-Rényi储备池的负号比例如何影响回声状态网络在Mackey-Glass基准任务上的内部动力学与预测性能。为了刻画储备池的响应，我们使用了两个基于香农熵的可观测量，即节点状态熵和节点频率熵，作为储备池状态多样性与时间激活模式的经验代理指标。我们发现，在所考察的任务中，中等水平的负号比例相比符号同质的极端情况具有更丰富的内部动力学，并显著降低了预测误差。这些结果表明，连边符号组成可以成为面向混沌预测的储备池设计中一个有用的结构参数。
tldr: 带符号储备池中适度的负权重比例能够带来更丰富的内部动力学，并显著降低混沌时间序列预测的误差。
en_tdlr: An intermediate ratio of negative weights in a signed reservoir yields richer internal dynamics and substantially lower prediction error for chaotic time-series forecasting.
